name: ANCH
fix_description: Add require(sender != recipient) in _transfer to reject self-transfers. This blocks the Pair.skim(address(Pair)) loop: each skim triggers _transfer with sender==recipient==Pair, which would cancel out the main transfer but still grant bonus rewards from the contract balance, inflating Pair.balanceOf above reserves. After 60 iterations the attacker drains the surplus via skim(attacker).
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a short flash-loan-driven price/manipulation attack that requires understanding the vulnerable token/pair interaction, specifically how repeated skim calls can amplify balance distortions before swapping back for profit. While the PoC is compact, it is not a trivial access-control bug and needs protocol-specific reasoning about AMM reserve/accounting behavior and fee-on-transfer token mechanics.
